records.text: Owens said prosecutor Alana Minton reported newly discovered information that Crofts’s classroom door may have been locked, making intent difficult to establish, and the case was subsequently dropped.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: What then happened was the Canyon County prosecuting attorney, Alana Minton, told the judge that a new piece of information came to light that we had previously been unaware of the new information. ... was that the door to Crofts's classroom may have been locked at the time of the alleged incident. ... They couldn't establish intent. It would be difficult for them to prove his intent for a child to see him. So they're not disputing that he was doing what he was doing. ... They're disputing the child's version of events and his version of events and establishing intent. Anyway, he ends up getting this dropped.
